_comment: Regressions beyond the baseline threshold that the owner has accepted (PRD AOS-23.2: a regression > 10 % blocks the phase exit until it is fixed or the owner accepts it in the report).

Each entry: metric = an id of docs/perf/baseline.json; reason = why it is accepted (required); plus accepted_by, date and the report that records it. Remove the entry once the baseline is re-recorded past it.

Example: {"metric": "crash-resume.restart_boot_ms", "reason": "six more modules register at boot; the crashed job resumes as fast as before", "accepted_by": "owner", "date": "2026-11-21", "report": "PHASE2_REPORT §7"}
